subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt or review https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544 for this Control UI resolver fix, or close it and request a fresh same-repository current-main PR?
rationale: The source-level issue remains valid, but an open linked cross-repository PR already contains the focused resolver/test change and blocks a duplicate automated repair lane; its adoption or replacement needs maintainer handling.

options.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh it against current paths, collect real Control UI proof, and resolve stale validation state.

options.title: Request a fresh replacement
options.body: Leave the fork PR aside and ask for a same-repository UI-only resolver PR against current main with focused proof.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh it against current paths, collect real Control UI proof, and resolve stale validation state.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is closest to the channel UI metadata path and whether the existing fork patch should be adopted or replaced.
